item_name: Rothco Folding Noise Reduction Ear Muffs
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Folding Noise Reducing Ear Muffs are specially designed for hunters and shooting enthusiasts. These easy-to-pack ear muffs fold in half to take up minimal space in your gun case or range bag.
description: Rothco’s Folding Noise Reducing Ear Muffs are specially designed for hunters and shooting enthusiasts. These easy-to-pack ear muffs fold in half to take up minimal space in your range bag. These ear muffs feature a comfortable padded headband and slide-adjusting earcups for a comfortable fit. These lightweight hunting ear muffs fold in half for easy storage. With an NRR value or 32 (+/- 3db), these ear muffs are perfect for hunters, tactical professionals, and gun enthusiasts.
